substats: Skill AMP + crit rate
why: Crit rate beats crit DMG: opponents stack crit RES and Moon Rabbit cuts crit. One accuracy line optional.

substats: Skill Haste + Skill AMP (Rye and Brightseeker decks)
why: The only Skill Haste a Rye deck keeps: three lines.

substats: Skill AMP + crit rate (Bari decks)
why: Zero haste: Bari decks stake the fight on the first hit.

substats: Crit RES + DR
why: Most Arena damage crits. Past about 60% crit RES, DR is worth more.

substats: Skill Haste + crit RES (or DR)
why: Kept the sixth Skill Haste line while adding survival.

obsolete.reason: Swapping this haste for DR + crit RES won far more often; posters call six haste a scam.

substats: DR + crit RES (or DR + HP)
why: Replaced Skill Haste here: the team survives the opening far more often.

substats: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces
why: Whoever cast first won, so heal and shield decks ran six haste lines.

obsolete.reason: Six haste lost the opening: 3 lines won more for a Rye deck, and Bari decks run none.

substats: Skill Haste lines: Bari decks 0, Rye and Brightseeker decks 3
why: Bari decks bet on the first hit; Rye decks trade haste for survival.

substats: About 230% unbuffed crit on a Bari deck
why: So the dive still crits through Moon Rabbit's debuff.

substats: No accuracy or focus (at most one accuracy line)
why: Typical evasion is about 650, so accuracy is dead weight outside evasion matchups.

substats: A separate arena preset
why: PvP lines show little power, so the preset looks weaker than it is.

substats: Evasion preset: evasion + crit RES and evasion + Skill Haste below, Focus + Skill Haste top-right, Skill AMP top-left
why: Evasion deck only: about 1,000–1,400 evasion. Loses to any accuracy preset.

substats: Attack evasion defenders on the stage preset (accuracy)
why: Accuracy cancels evasion. Names are visible, so remember who runs it.

substats: Wear the arena preset, not the stage preset
why: Players who forgot kept losing to equal-power opponents.

substats: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces
why: The Arena & Rumble guide applied the six-haste rule to both modes.

obsolete.reason: Rumble guides now run three haste lines on Rye decks and none on Bari decks.

substats: Rye decks: Skill Haste only top-right (3 lines)
why: Same template as Arena; bottom-right goes DR + crit RES.

substats: Bari decks: no Skill Haste
why: Hasted chargers run in before the buffs land.

substats: DR + crit RES, with RES (저항) this season
why: RES resists Moon Rabbit's debuff; DR beats crit RES against her crit cut.

substats: Two accuracy lines, on attack or defense
why: Evasion defenses spread higher up; two lines bounce them.

substats: Evasion set (about 1,000–1,500 evasion)
why: Hidden names stop opponents remembering it. Accuracy beats it.

substats: Top rankers attack on their stage (accuracy) preset
why: Reportedly, to beat evasion defenders. An observation, not a guide.
